episodes.synopsis: Unusual circumstances forces Yuta and Rikka to live under one roof. Keeping it under wraps is top priority as the new school year starts.
episodes.title: Wicked Lord Shingan... Reborn

episodes.synopsis: Nibutani becomes obsessed with the state of Yuta and Rikka's questionable romance, and pressures Yuta to take control of his girlfriend and lead her down the righteous path of boy-girl relationships.
episodes.title: Dolphin Ring Striker

episodes.synopsis: Rikka becomes very excited about the presence of a magic user she is supposedly doing unvisible battle with, but it soon becomes apparent that this magic user is an actual person. She is a girl Yuta knows from his middle school days who first infected him with chunibyo. Rikka is both fascinated and terrified of the threat the new girl poses to her and Yuta's love contract, and either wants to be friends with her or be rid of her for all eternity.
episodes.title: Magical Devil Girl in Pursuit

episodes.synopsis: Nibutani attempts to run for Student Council president, but a pesky little blonde girl is foiling her every attempt at normalcy. What can she do to keep her in check? The unthinkable...
episodes.title: The Election for President of the Student Council (Queen Maker)... of Purity

episodes.synopsis: In danger of losing the club room, The Magical Napping Society - Summer thereof decides to do the only club activity that the student council will accept: competitive napping!
episodes.title: Meeting of Club Delegates Meeting

episodes.synopsis: The class trip is here, and while Rikka and Dekomori must separate, now is a good time for her to get some alone time with Yuta... if their class mates let them!
episodes.title: Travelling to the Island of Tsukushi... of Hesitation

episodes.synopsis: Togashi hopes to spend the entire day alone with Rikka, but Shichimiya somehow finds her way to the couple, dragging them into her secret mission.
episodes.title: Triangle... of Missed Encounters

episodes.synopsis: A NEW Fake Mori Summer appears, hell bent of taking Dekomori as her own. But her sinister motives are discovered and only the REAL Fake Mori Summer can make her relinquish her hold on Sanae!
episodes.title: The False... "Holy Spirit Mother" (Morisummer)

episodes.synopsis: While helping Kumin's aunt run a shop by the beach, Rikka realizes that her powers are fading... and she may want them to.
episodes.title: Resort... Last Resort

episodes.synopsis: Shichimiya continues to wrestle with her newfound feelings, and only one thing can save her from herself: a showdown!
episodes.title: A Midsummer Night's... Rain and Whips (Gauntlet of Rain)

episodes.synopsis: Rikka is determined to find the necessary items to revive the Dark Flame Dragon, and puts herself in danger in the process.
episodes.title: Blue Moon Ragnarok

episodes.synopsis: Rikka is acting strangely around Yuta, and it takes all of her courage to confess her true feelings to him.
episodes.title: The Superior Contract... of Twilight
